tagline: First king to the last rank wins.
description: No pawns, no checks and no checkmate. Both armies start on the first rank and race their kings to the far side of the board.

sections.markdown:
Both armies start side by side on the first two ranks, White on the right and Black on the left, with no pawns. White moves first.

- **The goal.** Be the first to move your **king onto the eighth rank**. You win the moment it arrives.
- **No checks.** A move that gives check is not allowed, and neither is a move that leaves your own king attacked.
- **The other pieces.** The **queen**, **rooks**, **bishops** and **knights** move and capture as in chess. There is no castling.

A player with no legal move draws.

Two differences from the real game: here the first king to arrive wins outright, while normally Black gets one more move to reach the eighth rank too and make it a draw. There is also no draw by repetition or by the fifty-move rule.
